status: initial admitted seed; corpus-wide candidate scan remains human-adjudicated

records.title: Hidden material memories are not separately observed by one scalar lock record
records.claimTested: Adding explicit thermal and photorefractive coordinates to the estimator is sufficient to whiten the scalar lock innovation in the declared slow-memory twin.
records.scope: Dimensionless three-mode lithium-niobate twin; one scalar common-detuning detector; declared augmented EKF and slow-memory scenario.
records.test: Matched-seed phase-paired simulation comparing reduced and augmented-memory EKF strategies.
records.testAdequacy: Adequate to compare the declared estimators in the declared twin; not adequate to decide a physical device or every possible excitation.
records.observation: The augmented-memory estimator did not reduce lag-one innovation correlation relative to the reduced EKF.
records.licensedInference: Naming additional hidden states does not make them observable through this scalar record and estimator design.
refusedInferences: thermal and photorefractive states are never distinguishable
EKF is generally invalid
the physical device has the simulated parameters
records.reopeningCondition: Add an independently calibrated slow-memory readout or designed excitation that makes the thermal and photorefractive coordinates separately observable, then rerun identification and innovation tests.
records.cheapestReopenDatum: Two-timescale excitation/recovery record with an independent temperature or charge-sensitive channel.

records.title: One-step predictive locking is brittle under the declared long delay
records.claimTested: The declared reduced-EKF one-step constrained predictive command improves lock RMS under a nine-step command delay.
records.scope: One controller formula, one normalized long-delay scenario and its matched-seed phase pair.
records.test: Compare lock RMS against linear-Kalman PI and reduced-EKF PI in the long-delay stress scenario.
records.testAdequacy: Adequate to reject this implementation in this scenario; not a test of full model-predictive or robust control.
records.observation: The predictive strategy produced materially larger lock RMS than both PI strategies.
records.licensedInference: This predictive implementation should not be promoted for the declared delay regime.
refusedInferences: all predictive control is delay brittle
PI is universally optimal
records.reopeningCondition: Identify the physical delay and plant, then evaluate a horizon-based controller with an explicit delay state and robustness margin.
records.cheapestReopenDatum: Applied-command to measured-response delay distribution from the pilot device.

records.title: Hard detector clipping erases amplitude without a side channel
records.claimTested: A clipped scalar detector record alone uniquely recovers pre-clipping amplitude over the saturated region.
records.scope: Hard many-to-one clipping map with no independent unsaturated channel or restrictive prior.
assumptions: no prior that uniquely fixes lost amplitude
records.test: Information-map analysis plus a stress case with clipping occupancy above 0.8.
records.testAdequacy: The non-injectivity of the clipping map exactly decides uniqueness within the stated scope.
records.observation: Distinct amplitudes map to the same clipped value and all tested controllers degrade.
records.licensedInference: No estimator can reconstruct arbitrary erased amplitude uniquely from that clipped scalar record alone.
refusedInferences: clipped experiments contain no useful information
a second detector cannot repair the loss
records.reopeningCondition: Change the detector class by increasing dynamic range, adding a calibrated unsaturated side channel or imposing and validating a uniquely resolving prior.
records.cheapestReopenDatum: Simultaneous low-gain detector channel spanning the clipped region.
records.authorityCeiling: exact information-map no-go within declared detector class

records.title: Stationary Gaussian density does not imply detailed balance
records.claimTested: A stationary Gibbs or Gaussian density alone proves zero probability current and reversible dynamics.
records.scope: Markov diffusion inference from stationary density without current or generator data.
assumptions: stationary density is the only retained observable
records.test: Construct a stable Gaussian diffusion with nonzero rotational stationary current.
records.testAdequacy: One exact counterexample refutes the universal implication.
records.observation: The stationary Gaussian law is unchanged while rotational probability current is nonzero.
records.licensedInference: Stationary density alone cannot certify detailed balance.
refusedInferences: no Gaussian diffusion is reversible
Gibbs measures are physically irrelevant
records.reopeningCondition: Measure or derive the generator/current and prove reversibility in the stated measure.
records.authorityCeiling: exact counterexample to a universal implication

records.title: Input-selective recurrence is not one fixed convolution
records.claimTested: A nonlinear input-selective recurrence is representable by one fixed linear convolution for all inputs.
records.scope: Declared selective scalar recurrence and fixed linear convolution class.
records.test: Test superposition on two sequences and their sum.
records.testAdequacy: Violation of linear superposition exactly excludes a fixed linear convolution representation.
records.observation: Response to the summed input differs from the sum of responses.
records.licensedInference: The selective recurrence cannot be globally replaced by one fixed linear convolution.
refusedInferences: selective recurrences have no convolutional local approximations
state-space realization is impossible
records.reopeningCondition: Change the target to an input-conditioned kernel, local linearization or lifted nonlinear state representation.
records.cheapestReopenDatum: Declared conditioning variable and kernel family.

records.title: Finite Newton--Schulz is not exact polar normalization near small singular values
records.claimTested: A fixed finite number of the declared Newton--Schulz steps equals the exact polar factor uniformly near zero singular value.
records.scope: Declared finite polynomial iteration at five steps and normalized small scalar singular value witness.
records.test: Compare the finite iterate with the exact scalar polar factor.
records.testAdequacy: Exact numerical-algebraic witness decides equality for the stated iteration and input.
records.observation: The finite iterate remains far from the exact polar factor.
records.licensedInference: Finite-depth Muon-style normalization cannot be silently replaced by exact polar normalization in this regime.
refusedInferences: Newton--Schulz never converges
finite iteration is always harmful
records.reopeningCondition: Supply a singular-value domain and iteration depth with a proved approximation bound, or retain the finite map as the actual algorithm.
records.cheapestReopenDatum: Smallest singular-value bound for the intended update matrices.

records.title: Scalar transfer cannot identify an unobservable internal mode
records.claimTested: One scalar input-output transfer uniquely identifies every internal state direction without observability assumptions.
records.scope: Finite-dimensional linear state-space systems with a declared scalar port.
assumptions: hidden state direction in the kernel of the observability map
records.test: Construct a three-state realization with controllability and observability rank one.
records.testAdequacy: Exact rank certificate and indistinguishable output histories decide the scoped identifiability claim.
records.observation: Two internal directions remain unreachable and invisible while the scalar transfer is well defined.
records.licensedInference: Scalar transfer data do not identify the full carrier unless minimality is independently established.
refusedInferences: state-space models are unphysical
multiport tomography cannot repair observability
records.reopeningCondition: Add ports or designed excitations until the observability and controllability maps have adequate singular-value floors.
records.cheapestReopenDatum: Full multiport complex response over the target band.

records.title: Scalar impedance cannot identify dark holonomy
records.claimTested: Complete scalar poles and residues identify a moving degenerate eigenspace and its holonomy.
records.scope: Finite self-adjoint family compressed through a scalar port blind to a dark doublet.
records.test: Construct a moving dark doublet with exact quarter-turn holonomy and constant scalar response.
records.testAdequacy: The exact indistinguishable pair refutes scalar identifiability.
records.observation: Scalar impedance remains constant while the hidden projector undergoes nontrivial holonomy.
records.licensedInference: Scalar poles and residues cannot identify holonomy wholly contained in the dark detector subspace.
refusedInferences: holonomy is unmeasurable
matrix residues are unnecessary
records.reopeningCondition: Use a calibrated matrix-valued port map whose residues have full rank on the target degenerate cluster.
records.cheapestReopenDatum: Second phase-coherent port exposing the dark doublet.

records.title: Reported YIG three-mode chain cannot host the required protected doublet
records.claimTested: The reported photon--magnon--phonon three-mode chain realizes the corpus's protected two-dimensional dark subspace with both couplings nonzero.
records.scope: Reported three-mode chain topology and protected-doublet requirement.
records.test: Compute the dark-space dimension at triple resonance and across the admitted coupling domain.
records.testAdequacy: Exact rank/eigenspace calculation decides the required dark dimension.
records.observation: The reported chain has only a one-dimensional dark space.
records.licensedInference: That three-mode architecture cannot realize the requested protected doublet.
refusedInferences: YIG is unsuitable for all memory or hybridization experiments
a four-mode YIG extension cannot work
records.reopeningCondition: Add an independently controllable fourth mode to form a tripod and re-evaluate protected-doublet splitting, loss and tomography.
records.cheapestReopenDatum: Measured four-mode susceptibility with the proposed auxiliary mode.

records.title: A bare trifilar braid does not generate geometric holonomy
records.claimTested: Cyclic exchange of three fixed conductor eigenvectors alone produces nontrivial adiabatic geometric holonomy.
records.scope: Symmetric bare three-conductor braid with a fixed differential plane and no tunable moving projector.
records.test: Derive the common/differential quotient, symplectic lift and projector connection.
records.testAdequacy: The projector is constant, so its geometric connection and curvature vanish exactly.
records.observation: The braid acts as an algebraic rotation inside a fixed plane but produces no adiabatic projector holonomy.
records.licensedInference: Braid permutation alone is insufficient for the claimed holonomy.
refusedInferences: trifilar systems have no useful modal geometry
a tunable moving-projector repair is impossible
records.reopeningCondition: Introduce independently tunable couplings or loads that move the bright vector while preserving a gap, then measure the transported projector.
records.cheapestReopenDatum: Calibrated tunable three-mode matrix along one closed moving-projector loop.

records.title: Dimensionless twin cannot select a hardware controller or effect size
records.claimTested: The dimensionless nonlinear twin determines the physical device's best estimator/controller and confirmatory sample size.
records.scope: Current software twin without measured A,B,C,D,Q,R, delays, units, safety limits or device covariance.
assumptions: effective rather than microscopic memory model
records.test: Twenty phase-paired strategy/scenario simulations plus software acceptance checks.
records.testAdequacy: Adequate for architecture stress and regression; inadequate for hardware ranking or power analysis.
records.observation: Strategy rankings change by scenario and all numerical scales are normalized development choices.
records.licensedInference: The software architecture has survived declared stresses and exposed failure modes; hardware choice remains undecided.
refusedInferences: the reduced EKF will win on hardware
the normalized lock RMS predicts a linewidth fraction
the simulation determines sample size
records.reopeningCondition: Acquire the preregistered blinded pilot identification bundle and replace every normalized parameter with measured values and covariance.
records.cheapestReopenDatum: One-device multiport pilot with synchronized applied-command and phase-referenced detector streams.

authorityBoundary: A retained negative result blocks only its typed claim and scope. It does not become a universal refutation by repetition or rhetoric.
